achievements.name: Meet Pauline
achievements.detail: After the fall from Ingot Isle, find Pauline and head deeper underground with her.

achievements.name: Smash a Path
achievements.detail: Smash through a wall or floor to carve a path that was not there before.

achievements.name: Banandium Gem
achievements.detail: Pick up a Banandium Gem, one of the golden bananas hidden in a layer.

achievements.name: Skill Point
achievements.detail: Spend a Skill Point earned from Banandium Gems on a new skill.

achievements.name: Kong Bananza
achievements.detail: Transform into Kong Bananza and break terrain that normal punches leave standing.

achievements.name: Zebra Bananza
achievements.detail: Use Zebra Bananza to sprint across water or a path that is crumbling away.

achievements.name: Ostrich Bananza
achievements.detail: Fly as Ostrich Bananza and drop an egg bomb on an enemy below.

achievements.name: Elephant Bananza
achievements.detail: Use Elephant Bananza to inhale terrain and throw it.

achievements.name: Fossil Outfit
achievements.detail: Trade fossils for a piece of clothing for Donkey Kong or Pauline.

achievements.name: Ruins Challenge
achievements.detail: Clear a challenge in the ancient ruins and collect the Banandium Gem waiting there.

achievements.name: VoidCo Route
achievements.detail: Defeat a Void Company enemy that is blocking the way into a lower layer.

achievements.name: Planet Core
achievements.detail: Travel down through the underground layers and reach the Planet Core.
